اختلسا (form VIII)
# اِخْتَلَسَا (iḵtalasā) /ix.ta.la.saː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِخْتَلَسَ (iḵtalasa)
# اُخْتُلِسَا (uḵtulisā) /ux.tu.li.saː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِخْتَلَسَ (iḵtalasa)
# اِخْتَلِسَا (iḵtalisā) /ix.ta.li.saː/: second-person dual imperative of اِخْتَلَسَ (iḵtalasa)
